methodologyNotes: Pricing sourced from official vendor pricing pages fetched June 2026 (accessedAt 2026-06-14). Where official pages returned no USD figures (Absorb, LearnUpon, Docebo, Litmos), monthlyUsd is set to null and billingModel to 'custom'. TalentLMS annual prices ($119/$229/$449/mo) confirmed from official talentlms.com/prices page; month-to-month prices ($149/$299/$579/mo) corroborated via Capterra/Software Finder. 360Learning Team plan price ($8/user/mo, billed monthly, no annual commitment) confirmed directly on official 360learning.com/pricing page and getapp.com. iSpring Learn Business: the previously-recorded $3.58/user/mo figure was set to null on adversarial re-verification — review aggregators disagree materially (300-user tier quoted at $4.46, 500-user at $3.97, 1,000-user at $3.58, with other sources showing $2.29-$3.14) and $3.58 could not be confirmed for the user tiers stated; the official page is JS-only. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null throughout — this is a non-telephony vertical.

vendors.name: TalentLMS
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.talentlms.com/prices fetched 2026-06-14. Annual prices ($119/$229/$449/mo) shown as the default 'Pay Yearly (Save 20%)' toggle; month-to-month prices ($149/$299/$579/mo) corroborated via softwareadvice.com.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 5 users, up to 10 courses. No credit card required.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Up to 40 users (base). $119/mo billed annually. Month-to-month rate is $149/mo. Includes unlimited courses, 1 branch, SSO, API.

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Up to 70 users (base). $229/mo billed annually. Month-to-month rate is $299/mo. Includes 3 branches, 5 Learning Paths, TalentCraft AI (10,000 credits/mo).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Up to 100 users base; $6/user/mo for additional users (Flex add-on). $449/mo billed annually. Month-to-month rate is $579/mo. Includes 15 branches, unlimited Learning Paths, TalentCraft AI (15,000 credits/mo).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Starts at 1,000 users (flexible from 500). Contact sales for pricing. Includes unlimited branches, TalentCraft AI unlimited (80,000 credits/mo), premium onboarding.

vendors.name: Docebo
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.docebo.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Page explicitly states 'Custom pricing tailored to your organization's needs.' No USD figures published. Targets organizations with 250+ learners.

plans.name: Elevate
plans.notes: Contact sales. Priced per user model: Monthly Active Users (MAU), Yearly Active Users (YAU), or Registered Active Users (RAU). Minimum 250+ learners.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Includes Skills Intelligence product. Pricing scales by user model and usage levels.

vendors.name: LearnUpon
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.learnupon.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. No USD prices published. Page shows three product lines (Employees from 100 users, Customer Education from 300 users, Associations from 150 users) all requiring sales contact.

plans.name: LearnUpon for Employees
plans.notes: Contact sales. Minimum 100 users. Includes implementation consulting, customer success support, 24/7 technical support.

plans.name: LearnUpon for Customer Education
plans.notes: Contact sales. Minimum 300 users. Enterprise plan includes white labelling, eCommerce, group branding.

vendors.name: Absorb LMS
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.absorblms.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Page renders a learner-count inquiry form only; no dollar figures published. Learner tiers shown: 1-50, 51-150, 151-250, 251-500, 501-1000, 1001-5000, 5001-25000, 25000+. Contact sales required for all tiers.

plans.name: Absorb LMS
plans.notes: Contact sales. Pricing varies by learner count (tiers: 1-50, 51-150, 151-250, 251-500, 501-1000, 1001-5000, 5001-25000, 25000+). No public pricing.

vendors.name: iSpring Learn
vendors.provenance: Official ispring.com pricing page rendered JS-only with no extractable pricing figures (fetched 2026-06-14). Business plan is per-active-user with tiered pricing (300/500/1,000 users per Capterra). On adversarial re-verification, review aggregators disagreed materially on the per-user rate (300-user $4.46, 500-user $3.97, 1,000-user $3.58; other sources $2.29-$3.14), so monthlyUsd is null and billingModel is 'custom' rather than asserting an unconfirmable single figure.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per-active-user pricing tied to user-count tiers (Business available at 300, 500, or 1,000 users per Capterra). monthlyUsd set to null: review aggregators disagree materially and the prior $3.58/user/mo figure could not be confirmed for the tiers listed — $3.58 corresponds to the 1,000-user tier in tier breakdowns, while 300/500-user tiers are quoted higher ($4.46 / $3.97) and other sources show $2.29-$3.14. Official ispring.com pricing page is JS-only with no extractable USD figures. Includes training automation, mobile apps with offline learning, custom roles, performance reviews, competency profiles, scheduled reports, corporate newsfeed, org chart, 24/7 live support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Supports up to 150,000 users. Includes on-premise installation option, dedicated premium support, SSO, unlimited APIs, out-of-the-box integrations.

vendors.name: 360Learning
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.360learning.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Team plan price of $8/user/mo confirmed directly on the page as 'billed monthly with no annual commitment, cancel anytime.' Business and Enterprise are custom/contact-sales. Corroborated via getapp.com.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $8 per user per month, billed monthly, no annual commitment, cancel anytime. Up to 100 users. Includes collaborative authoring, AI-assisted course creation, blended learning, ILT/vILT, learning analytics. Only pays for active users.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Contact sales. Flexible user model combining registered and monthly active users. Adds SSO, advanced integrations, dedicated success manager.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. For large organizations. Includes premium customer support, enterprise-wide L&D transformation features.

vendors.name: Litmos
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.litmos.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Page shows two plan names (Foundation and Platinum AI) but explicitly states pricing requires contacting sales. No USD figures published.

plans.name: Foundation
plans.notes: Contact sales. Up to 250 learners. Includes SCORM/xAPI, white-labeled design, ILT/vILT, learning paths, assessments, mobile app, reporting.

plans.name: Platinum AI
plans.notes: Contact sales. Mid-market and enterprise. Adds AI Assistant, AI Playlist, AI Content Authoring, AI assessments, 360-degree video, multiple branded experiences, SMS notifications, LRS, gamification, discussion forums, competencies/skills.
